children: Gold.com, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results with consolidated revenue of $25.513B and net income attributable to Gold.com, Inc. of $82.341M; diluted earnings per share were $3.02 for the year, driven by higher metal prices, forward sales and recent acquisitions.
Revenue was $25.513B, compared with $10.979B in the prior year; YoY change 132.4%.
Net income was $82.341M, compared with $17.32M in the prior year; YoY change 375.4%.
Diluted EPS was $3.02, compared with $0.71 in the prior year; YoY change 325.4%.
Revenue growth: Consolidated revenues surged 132% to $25.5B in FY2026, driven by higher metal prices, forward sales and acquisitions.
Channel shift: Direct-to-consumer (DTC) revenues rose 167%, with ticket volume up 63.9% and higher average order values supporting the DTC expansion.
Brand and M&A momentum: Completed acquisitions including SGI/Stack's Bowers, Pinehurst, AMS, Monex and SMI strengthened retail, auction, minting and global reach.
Wholesale dynamics: Wholesale ticket volume increased 13.9% with wider premium spreads but lower trading profits; inventory turnover improved to 13.8.
Secured lending & products: Secured lending interest income grew 9.7% to $11.7M even as secured loan counts declined; the company launched and expanded its CyberMetals digital fractional program.
